Examples.Title: Alter Alias
Examples.Description: This operation reassigns the alias of one collection to another.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create Alias
Examples.Description: This operation creates an alias for an existing collection.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Describe Alias
Examples.Description: This operation describes the details of a specific alias.
Examples.Code:
### Describe Alias
POST {{host}}/v2/vectordb/aliases/describe
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Request-Timeout: 
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "dbName": "string",
  "aliasName": "string"
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: An alias object that contains the detailed description of an alias.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Grant Role To User
Examples.Description: This operation grants a specified role to the current user. Once granted the role, the user gets permissions allowed for the current role and can perform certain operations.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: List Users
Examples.Description: This operation lists the information of all existing users.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Revoker Role From User
Examples.Description:
This operation revokes a privilege granted to the current role.
> Notes
> To complete this operation, you need to enable authentication on your Milvus instance. For details, refer to [Authenticate User Access](https://milvus.io/docs/authenticate.md).
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Delete
Examples.Description: This operation deletes entities by their IDs or with a boolean expression.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Get
Examples.Description: This operation gets specific entities by their IDs.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Insert
Examples.Description: This operation inserts data into a specific collection. You can insert a maximum of 100 entities at a time. To insert large volumes of data, please use [the bulk-insert API](https://docs.zilliz.com/docs/data-import).
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Query
Examples.Description: This operation conducts a filtering on the scalar field with a specified boolean expression.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Search
Examples.Description: This operation conducts a vector similarity search with an optional scalar filtering expression.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Upsert
Examples.Description: This operation inserts new records into the database or updates existing ones.  Currently, this endpoint does not apply to the collections that have autoId enabled.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Milvus;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.
